summary: Frontend-only regression for the two requested fixes (reception phone + Prenota Day Spa navbar button). Both fixes verified end-to-end on the public preview URL across IT/DE/FR/EN languages plus mobile menu. All regression checks (info section, tel: links, footer legal) pass. No runtime errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testid='nav-mobile-dayspa': one is assigned to the '#dayspa' section anchor generated from the NAV loop (labelFor slice) and the other to the actual Day Spa booking button. Strict Playwright selectors resolve to 2 elements. Rename one (e.g. nav-mobile-dayspa-link vs nav-mobile-dayspa-btn) to keep tests robust.

action_items: Rename duplicate data-testid on the mobile menu: the section anchor for '#dayspa' should NOT share data-testid with the mobile Day Spa booking button (both currently 'nav-mobile-dayspa'). Suggest 'nav-mobile-link-dayspa' for the section anchor.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar renders two elements with the same data-testid on mobile (nav-mobile-dayspa) — the NAV loop generates nav-mobile-{href.slice(1)} where href='#dayspa', colliding with the explicit Day Spa booking anchor. Purely testability, not functional.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both fixes verified: (1) Old phone '+39 049 8669111' is fully removed from the bundle (grep in /app/frontend/src returns nothing); the new number '+39 049 9939 200' appears in Info section and footer contact column with tel:+390499939200. Segreteria Cure remains +39 049 9939234 (tel:+390499939234). (2) Desktop nav has data-testid='nav-dayspa-btn' next to 'nav-book-btn' with target='_blank' and language-reactive hrefs: it→/it/day-spa/prenotazioni, en→/en/..., de→/de/..., fr→/fr/... . Labels: Prenota Day Spa / Book Day Spa / Day Spa Buchen / Réserver Day Spa. Mobile menu contains the Day Spa booking anchor as well, but its data-testid collides with the section anchor — use text or nth locator until renamed. Footer legal still shows CIN IT028089A18QYO48ED and Via Monteortone, 46. No runtime errors.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — this iteration is verification of fixes, not a bug hunt. The duplicate mobile data-testid arises because Navbar.jsx maps NAV entries to data-testid=`nav-mobile-${href.slice(1)}`, and href='#dayspa' produces the same id as the explicit Day Spa book anchor added below the loop.
